items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: the best drummers that I remember they had here was Lloyd Cottrell, Baby Matthews, Baby Dodds, Henry Martin, Red Happy, and Black Benny.

ctx.x: That was about one of the best drummers you had here. Well, really, the best drummers that I remember they had here was Lloyd Cottrell, Baby Matthews, Baby Dodds, Henry Martin, Red Happy, and Black Benny.
Who was the drummer Two Bits? Do you remember what his name was?
